business_summary: J Steel Company Holdings Inc. manufactures and sells rolling products in South Korea. It offers mild steel wire rods, BIC coiled rebar, and deformed rebars, as well as hot-rolled and extruded products. The company was formerly known as Jeil Steel Mfg Co., Ltd. and changed its name to J Steel Company Holdings Inc. in March 2022. J Steel Company Holdings Inc. was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Ansan-si, South Korea.
business_summary_ko: J Steel Company Holdings Inc.는 한국에서 압연 제품을 제조 및 판매합니다. 연강선재, BIC 코일철근, 이형철근은 물론 열연, 압출제품도 생산하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 제일제강주식회사로 알려졌으며 2022년 3월에 J스틸컴퍼니홀딩스(J Steel Company Holdings Inc.)로 사명을 변경했습니다. J스틸컴퍼니홀딩스(J Steel Company Holdings Inc.)는 1964년에 설립되었으며 대한민국 안산시에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
